meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: The Best of FIFA World Cup Korea & Japan 2002™, Icons of the Women's Game, The Best of FIFA Women's World Cup USA 2003™, FACTS: Germany FR v Argentina | Italy 90, A Look Back: 1994 FIFA World Cup USA™
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
